nodes.title: SG-1 · Set up UI stack, design system and responsive shell
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend is a React 18 + Vite app whose layout is a plain CSS grid (src/styles.css, GameLayout.tsx) with local useState drawer state and a RoundBadge/Countdown rendered inside the scene. It has no Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix, Zustand, Motion or Lucide. Desired behavior: the stack is configured, a Zustand store owns UI flags, the shell is a full-viewport 80/20 layout with a mobile bottom drawer, and a compact header overlay shows the world and round state. Why: this is the foundation for the Phaser redesign.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the frontend package, when package.json and tailwind config are read, then tailwindcss, radix, zustand, motion and lucide-react are declared and Tailwind scans src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
- Given the UI store, when its actions are called, then drawer, modal, sound and settings flags change as specified
- Given a desktop viewport, when the shell renders, then the game area has the 80% column class and the story panel the 20% column class with overflow hidden on the root
- Given a mobile viewport, when the shell renders, then the story panel is a bottom drawer toggled by the store and the scene stays mounted
- Given the header overlay, when rendered, then it shows logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings button


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend config, store, GameLayout, header overlay, App composition
- Out of scope: Phaser integration
- Out of scope: asset manifest
- Out of scope: new gameplay logic
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Preserve: useGame business logic
- Preserve: API client contracts
- Preserve: existing admin app


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript + Vite
- Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Zustand, Motion, Lucide React
- No Firebase, no database


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered with passing unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- No page scroll or horizontal overflow


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix, Motion and Lucide are configured in game/frontend
nodes.body:
Context: package.json has only react, react-dom and yaml. Desired behavior: add tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, zustand, motion, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-dialog, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, with tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js, components.json, a cn helper and Tailwind directives in styles.css. Result: any component can use Tailwind utilities and the cn helper. Why: design-system base.

- Given package.json, when read, then each listed dependency is declared
- Given tailwind.config.ts, when loaded, then content includes ./index.html and ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
- Given cn('a', false, 'b'), when called, then it returns 'a b' and merges conflicting Tailwind classes
- Given styles.css, when read, then it contains the @tailwind base, components and utilities directives


## Scope
- In scope: package.json, tailwind/postcss/shadcn config, cn helper, styles.css directives
- Out of scope: Phaser
- Out of scope: visual theme beyond base tokens
- Preserve: existing .contribution-sheet styles
- Preserve: vite/vitest config aliases


## Technical constraints
- Tailwind v3 with PostCSS


## Definition of done
- Dependencies and configs committed; app still builds

- None

nodes.title: REQ · A Zustand store holds drawer, modal, sound and settings UI state
nodes.body:
Context: drawer state is local useState in GameLayout and the contribution sheet flag is local in App. Desired behavior: one Zustand store useUiStore owns drawerOpen, modal ('contribution'|'settings'|null), soundEnabled and settingsOpen with actions. Why: Phaser and React must share UI state without duplicated ownership.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the initial store, when read, then drawerOpen false, modal null, soundEnabled true, settingsOpen false
- Given toggleDrawer called twice, when read, then drawerOpen is true then false
- Given openModal('contribution') then closeModal, when read, then modal is 'contribution' then null
- Given toggleSound called, when read, then soundEnabled is false
- Given setSettingsOpen(true), when read, then settingsOpen is true


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/store/uiStore.ts
- Out of scope: game state (stays in useGame)
- Preserve: useGame


## Technical constraints
- Zustand


## Definition of done
- Store exported with types


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Shell renders a full-viewport 80/20 layout with a mobile bottom drawer
nodes.body:
Context: GameLayout uses local state and min-height 100vh CSS grid, which can scroll the page. Desired behavior: root is h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden; desktop (md and up) grid columns 4fr/1fr with the story column scrolling independently; below md the story panel is a fixed bottom drawer driven by useUiStore.drawerOpen; the Story toggle and scene stay mounted. Why: no page scroll and reachable controls on mobile.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given GameLayout rendered, when inspected, then the root has overflow-hidden, h-screen and w-screen and the grid has md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr]
- Given the Story button clicked, when the store is read, then drawerOpen toggles and aria-expanded matches while the scene stays mounted
- Given the story aside, when inspected, then it has overflow-y-auto and exactly one .story-panel exists
- Given drawerOpen true, when rendered, then only the aside has drawer-open


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout.tsx, styles.css layout rules
- Out of scope: header
- Out of scope: Phaser
- Preserve: Story button name
- Preserve: story-content class
- Preserve: existing aria-expanded behavior


## Technical constraints
- Tailwind classes; state from useUiStore


## Dependencies
- REQ1
- REQ2


## Definition of done
- Layout classes in place


## Non-functional requirements
- No horizontal overflow


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A compact header overlay shows logo, world, round state, countdown, sound toggle and settings
nodes.body:
Context: RoundBadge and Countdown render loose inside the scene; no logo, world name, round ID, sound or settings controls; a failed round API shows only 'Round unavailable'. Desired behavior: HeaderOverlay absolutely positioned at the top of the scene shows a Lucide logo with StoryForge text, world name, round ID, RoundBadge, Countdown, a sound toggle (Volume2/VolumeX) bound to soundEnabled and a settings button that sets settingsOpen; with a round error it shows the failure message. Why: required compact header and explained errors.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a round, when HeaderOverlay renders, then it shows StoryForge, the world name, the round id, the status and a countdown
- Given the sound toggle clicked, when the store is read, then soundEnabled flips and aria-pressed matches
- Given the settings button clicked, when the store is read, then settingsOpen is true
- Given an error prop and no round, when rendered, then the error message text is visible instead of a bare 'Round unavailable'
- Given App rendered after Begin, when inspected, then HeaderOverlay is present and the Suggest button opens via the store modal


## Scope
- In scope: HeaderOverlay.tsx, App.tsx composition, RoundBadge unchanged
- Out of scope: settings dialog content
- Out of scope: audio playback
- Preserve: Countdown and RoundBadge components
- Preserve: ContributionSheet props
- Preserve: getCurrentRound call


## Technical constraints
- Lucide icons; Motion fade-in; Tailwind


## Dependencies
- REQ2
- REQ3


## Definition of done
- Header visible in the shell


## Non-functional requirements
- Buttons have aria-labels


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Define type UiModal = 'contribution' | 'settings' | null; interface UiState with drawerOpen, modal, soundEnabled, settingsOpen and actions toggleDrawer, setDrawerOpen(open), openModal(m), closeModal, toggleSound, setSettingsOpen(open); export useUiStore = create<UiState>() with initial drawerOpen false, modal null, soundEnabled true, settingsOpen false
